invariants.claim: Every continuing path has winnerRedeemed false and status exactly NftWon or CashWon.
Before ownership is accepted, ticketId is bound to the winning entry by inline range validation or to the already recorded winningTicketId by equality.
Only the exact current ticket owner, not merely an approved operator, can redeem.
On success, winnerRecipient, the burned ticket's last owner, and the NFT or cash recipient are the same winner address.
The winning ticket is burned before either external asset-delivery interaction; its range remains historical.
The NFT path sets prizeClaimed before transfer and completes only if the prize reports winner as owner afterward.
The cash path consumes the entire nonzero winnerProceeds bucket and zeroes it before quote-token interaction.
WinningTicketRedeemed is emitted only after the selected delivery path completes; branch-inapplicable fields remain zero.

Receives raffle, winner, and configured prizeTokenId; revert, callbacks, gas exhaustion, or nonstandard transfer behavior prevent completion or remain governed by the declared prize trust assumption (Raffle.sol:L334; IRaffle.sol:L12-L15).

sharedState: status and winningEntry: written by fulfillRandomWords (Raffle.sol:L518-L523), read here at L311-L312 and through winning-range validation.

settlementComplete, winningTicketId, unsettledPot, winnerProceeds, sponsorProceeds, protocolFees: written by _settleWinningTicket through standalone or inline settlement (Raffle.sol:L304-L315,L533-L557).
winnerRecipient and winnerRedeemed: written only by this function before burn/delivery (Raffle.sol:L323-L325).

Ticket ownership, balance, and approvals: minted by buyEntries, transferable through inherited ERC721 entrypoints and Raffle._update, burned by redemption/refund (Raffle.sol:L226-L236,L349-L365,L497-L502; ERC721.sol:L92-L136,L216-L245).

prizeClaimed and external prize custody: initial custody is verified by factory creation; this function consumes it for NftWon, while releaseSponsorPrize consumes it only for CashWon or Refunding (RaffleFactory.sol:L127-L134; Raffle.sol:L329-L337,L395-L405).

Quote custody and accounted liabilities: buyEntries funds unsettledPot; settlement allocates it; redemption and independent release functions consume their respective buckets (Raffle.sol:L223-L233,L339-L342,L375-L390,L468-L470,L539-L555).

Shared reentrancy guard: all raffle claim/release entrypoints use the same guard, while inherited ERC721 transfer/approval entrypoints do not (Raffle.sol:L304-L395; ERC721.sol:L92-L136; ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L105).
